title: Vera never reads the persona a member picked, so her welcome and her answers ignore who signed up
detail: PR 7 (ADR-1715). buildVeraSystem puts one plain reader note built from profiles.meta.persona and meta.archetype into the volatile block (for example: This member signed up to host). Age band and gender are never passed. lib/onboarding/vera-welcome.ts branches the opening: a host gets the start one Circle handoff, a practitioner gets open a free Space, everyone else keeps the tour. A unit test builds the prompt for a host and finds the note.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch{return ""}};const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const v=r("lib/ai/vera/agent-claude.ts");if(!/\.persona\b/.test(v))fail("Vera system prompt never reads the member persona");if(/ageBand|age_band|gender/.test(v))fail("Vera prompt would carry age or gender");if(!/host/i.test(r("lib/onboarding/vera-welcome.ts"))||!/persona/.test(r("lib/onboarding/vera-welcome.ts")))fail("Vera welcome does not branch by persona")'
verify.note: Fails while Vera's prompt never reads the persona, carries age or gender, or the welcome does not branch by persona.
